# Helpful Resources

Here's all the resources you may need as you begin your move to Dallas:

- [PowerToChoose](https://www.powertochoose.org/){target="_blank"} — Official electricity-plan comparison site
- [NTTA TollTag](https://www.ntta.org/){target="_blank"} — TollTag registration and account management
- [DART](https://www.dart.org/){target="_blank"} — Fares, routes, rail, buses, and GoPass
- [Texas DPS](https://www.dps.texas.gov/){target="_blank"} — Driver's license information and appointments

:::

::: {.section-dark}

# PMG Pre-Engagement

- [ ] Ask the P&C Team for additional onboarding recommendations
- [ ] Review PMGer apartment and neighborhood suggestions
- [ ] Confirm first-day office details
- [ ] Save important PMG contacts

# Set Up in Dallas

- [ ] Choose an apartment
- [ ] Set up electricity before move-in
- [ ] Set up renter's insurance
- [ ] Order an NTTA TollTag
- [ ] Complete the emissions inspection
- [ ] Register the vehicle within 30 days
- [ ] Update auto insurance to Texas minimums
- [ ] Get a Texas driver's license within 90 days
- [ ] Download the DART GoPass app
- [ ] Update mailing address with USPS, bank, and employer
- [ ] Register to vote, if desired

:::
